description: Scan a local codebase and submit it to VibeMap for AI-powered reverse engineering. The server-side generation persists FEATURES from the code digest. It does NOT persist user stories or acceptance criteria — after the features task completes (poll vibemap_get_generation_status), create those yourself with vibemap_create_user_story and vibemap_create_acceptance_criterion, using your full codebase access for accuracy. Returns a sessionId to poll.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the local project directory

projectId.description: The VibeMap project to populate with discovered specs

name: vibemap_analyze_codebase
